title: Six-material shared-host execution-cost bracket on the frozen fixed-head Layer-ROM frontier
purpose: Measure the implementation cost of the retained L4/L6/R8 Layer-ROM ladder relative to temporally qualified same-partition CoRichards and ultrafine R16 on the exact six-material fixed-head panel, without turning the shared-host result into a formal or portable speedup claim.

workload.complete_workload: all four frozen histories for one material

Reference.role: B1HCL ultrafine temporally qualified Reference execution

LayerROM_cost_semantics.reason: B1HCMR continuous-time fidelity uses independent SciPy DOP853/Radau oracles; timing those Python implementations against compiled Fortran would be an implementation-language comparison, not a Layer-ROM algorithm comparison.
bracket: BASE reports the cost of the exact finite-step research propagator originally used in B1H.
FINE reports a fourfold temporal-refinement sensitivity of the identical equations and closure.
Continuous-time scientific fidelity remains B1HCMR/B1HCP authority and is not replaced by either timing route.
LayerROM_cost_semantics.claim_rule: A cost advantage robust for both BASE and FINE is stronger shared-host evidence than BASE alone, but neither is a formal or portable speedup.

LayerROM_BASE: material parameters and frozen lambdas reproduce B1H materialization exactly
standalone Fortran equations are the already C4T-equivalence-qualified standard Layer-ROM equations with only material/history/horizon changes
O0 and O2 scientific stdout identical
LayerROM_FINE: identical source to BASE except dt=2.5e-5 and substeps-per-observation=40
O0 and O2 scientific stdout identical
CoRichards: benchmark-capable harness validation mode byte-reproduces the immutable B1HCN fine output, except B05 L6/R8 which byte-reproduce the immutable B1HCO ultra output
R16: benchmark-capable harness validation mode byte-reproduces immutable B1HCL ultrafine Reference stdout
compiled_equivalence_gates.failure_rule: Any material-route implementation-equivalence failure blocks timing for that material; no route or material may be dropped after timing exposure.

timing_protocol.primary_measure: in-process Fortran CPU_TIME around repeated complete four-history workloads
timing_protocol.order: 10 cyclic rotations of frozen base order plus 10 cyclic rotations of reversed base order; every route occupies every position exactly twice

statistics.pairwise: paired CPU delta over 20 position-balanced rounds with mean, sd, SE and two-SE interval

panel_summary_rules.route_cost_range_across_materials: report min/median/max of per-material mean ratios only as descriptive spread
panel_summary_rules.robust_reduction_signal: For a Layer-ROM dimension, both BASE and FINE are resolved cheaper than R16 on all six materials.
panel_summary_rules.same_partition_cost_signal: Report per material/dimension whether BASE and FINE are resolved cheaper than same-partition CoRichards; do not merge with fidelity into a scalar winner.

post_calibration_feasibility_amendment.timing_exposure_boundary: Only the R16 calibration route was executed. No Layer-ROM or CoRichards comparative timing sample and no position-balanced measured round had been exposed.
repair: Preserve the complete four-history material workload as the indivisible timing unit.
If repeats=1 already exceeds target_cpu_seconds_max, use repeats=1 as an ATOMIC_WORKLOAD_OVER_TARGET calibration instead of declaring calibration unresolved.
Do not change materials, histories, route set, compiler, fidelity authority, warmups, measured rounds, route order, checksum gate, pairwise statistics or resolution rule.
Report the calibration mode explicitly in every material result.
post_calibration_feasibility_amendment.rationale: The original upper calibration target assumed the atomic complete workload could fit below 4 CPU-s. B16 falsified that operational assumption before any comparative route timing was exposed. Subdividing the frozen four-history workload would change the workload; retaining repeats=1 preserves the preregistered workload and only relaxes an unattainable repetition-calibration convenience.
post_calibration_feasibility_amendment.performance_claim_effect: NONE; remains shared-host screening only with no formal or portable speedup claim
